title: Turn a big task into a clear plan
provenance: Original text authored for this prototype. Demonstration method, not externally researched advice or a claim of universal effectiveness.

blocks.text: A simple plan can make a big task clearer. This demonstration uses three actions: name the result, break the work into steps, and choose the next action.
First, name the result. Describe what finished looks like, instead of listing activities.
Next, break the work into small steps. Put them in an order you can follow.
Then choose the next action. Make it specific enough to begin without another planning session.
Name the result, break it down, and choose your next action.
